commit.message: feat(control): bind governed A2A and Sarathi adapters

interface_mismatches: Sarathi PlannedDelegation dependencies are proposal-local labels, while Mission Control dependencies are canonical task IDs; a complete explicit mapping is required before owner-state writes.
The current execution-lease digest is integrity evidence, not authenticated dispatch authority; the dispatch membrane requires an injected authenticity verifier.
A2A owns its task and transport lifecycle, so wrapping A2A publication in MissionControl start_attempt, heartbeat_lease, or finish_attempt would duplicate owner state.
NatsPublishAck and NatsConsumeAck encode distinct transport events and cannot be promoted into semantic outcomes.
RuntimeStateStore external-A2A lookup returns the latest matching identity, while durable receipt APIs are bounded; recovery must independently reject ambiguity and saturation.
Legacy Sarathi wake, mailbox, and receipt artifacts remain private projections and are not canonical Mission Control admission evidence.
honest_blockers: This packet adds adapters and tests only; it does not start Mission Control, Sarathi, an A2A consumer, JetStream, a worker pool, or a supervisor.
Authenticated dispatch authority is supplied by injected owner verification; task claims, self-hashed leases, identity assertions, and proposal contents are not authority.
A NATS publish acknowledgement proves broker acceptance only. It does not prove handler contact, executor liveness, semantic completion, verified outcome, promotion eligibility, or merge permission.
Runtime receipt recovery is bounded and must fail closed on scan saturation, ambiguity, conflicting identity, or changed operation content.
The latest-only external A2A identity lookup cannot prove fleet-global uniqueness.
Forge remains promotion authority and Merge Master Mike remains conditional merge authority.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the three additive adapters, their three tests, and this packet. No canonical schema, owner module, runtime process, transport topology, deployment, promotion state, or merge state is changed by this slice.
